instruments.name: Patient Health Questionnaire-2
instruments.purpose: Depression pre-screen (DoH Standard of Care step 1)

stem.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

items.en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless

instruments.on_positive: administer PHQ-9 (reuse phq_1 and phq_2 answers; do not ask twice)
instruments.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JB. The Patient Health Questionnaire-2: validity of a two-item depression screener. Med Care 2003;41:1284-92.

instruments.name: Patient Health Questionnaire-9

stem.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

items.en: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Feeling down, depressed, or hopeless
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Poor appetite or overeating
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

difficulty_item.en: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
difficulty_item.used_by: step_rules.v1.json → SM-01 functional impairment (value >= 2) and complexity flag functional_impairment_extreme (value == 3, SM-03)

scoring.missing_policy: If exactly 1 of items 1-8 is missing: prorated_total = round(sum_answered * 9 / 8), flag 'prorated'. If item 9 is missing: total is NOT computed as complete; crisis_item_unknown=true; the Crisis Gate treats this as 'unknown' and routes to clinician review (never as 0). If >= 2 items missing: status INCOMPLETE, no band, no step.
scoring.missing_policy_note: Conservative design choice for the MVP; requires clinical sign-off. Published PHQ guidance tolerates more missingness; we deliberately do not.

reliable_change.source: NHS Talking Therapies manual (reliable change PHQ-9 >= 6)

instruments.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JB. The PHQ-9: validity of a brief depression severity measure. J Gen Intern Med 2001;16:606-13. https://doi.org/10.1046/j.1525-1497.2001.016009606.x

instruments.name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder-2
instruments.purpose: Anxiety pre-screen (DoH Standard of Care step 1)

stem.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

items.en: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying

instruments.on_positive: administer GAD-7 (reuse gad_1 and gad_2 answers)
instruments.citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JB, Monahan PO, Löwe B. Anxiety disorders in primary care: prevalence, impairment, comorbidity, and detection. Ann Intern Med 2007;146:317-25.

instruments.name: Generalized Anxiety Disorder-7

stem.en: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by the following problems?

items.en: Feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge
Not being able to stop or control worrying
Worrying too much about different things
Trouble relaxing
Being so restless that it is hard to sit still

items.loinc_note: NLM Clinical Tables lists the long name of 69689-8 with 'last 4 weeks'; confirm this is the code used in the GAD-7 panel 69737-5 before FHIR export.
items.en: Becoming easily annoyed or irritable
Feeling afraid, as if something awful might happen

scoring.missing_policy: If exactly 1 item is missing: prorated_total = round(sum_answered * 7 / 6), flag 'prorated'. If >= 2 missing: status INCOMPLETE.

reliable_change.source: NHS Talking Therapies manual (reliable change GAD-7 >= 4)

instruments.citation: Spitzer RL, Kroenke K, Williams JB, Löwe B. A brief measure for assessing generalized anxiety disorder: the GAD-7. Arch Intern Med 2006;166:1092-7. https://doi.org/10.1001/archinte.166.10.1092

validation_rules: Every answer value must be an integer in the scale's range; anything else -> HTTP 422, never coerced.
Duplicate item ids in one submission -> 422.
Answers for an item id not in the instrument -> 422.

phq_1/phq_2 and gad_1/gad_2 answers given in the pre-screen are reused by the full instrument; a conflicting second answer for the same item in the same session -> keep the higher value and log 'conflicting_answer' (raise-only, mirrors the crisis principle).
Scores are stored with the rule-file version (E-17 RuleSetVersion) used to compute them.
